findings.observedBehavior: Valuation dataCompleteness is marked FULL from total company-fact count and time span, although the displayed valuation metric has only one usable observation. The product emits DENSE coverage and a one-year median equal to the current value while percentile remains null.
findings.cohortEvidence: 9/20: DYCL, HDFCBANK, INFY, RELIANCE, SUNPHARMA, TATAMOTORS, TATASTEEL, TCS and TITAN. Every one has DENSE/FULL, null current1YPercentile, and median1Y equal to currentValue.
productionEvidence: src/server/services/intelligence/valuation/ValuationIntelligenceEngine.ts:160 runCoverageAudit uses all canonical facts instead of facts for the requested valuation metric
src/server/services/intelligence/valuation/ValuationIntelligenceEngine.ts:141 sets FULL solely from audit density
findings.independentArithmetic: For TCS, current PE=15.06, reported median1Y=15.06 and percentile=null. A distribution with one observation cannot support a historical median/coverage claim.
findings.requiredOutcome: Metric-level historical coverage must gate each metric's median, range and percentile. Any metric with fewer than the configured number of dated observations must report DATA_INSUFFICIENT and null historical statistics; overall completeness may not be FULL when every presented valuation metric lacks a usable distribution.

findings.observedBehavior: QGLP reports NO_RED_FLAG_DETECTED whenever the FERE result object exists and has no warnings, including when FERE is DATA_INSUFFICIENT with zero evidence. The displayed risk-item evidence is an Upstox competitors snapshot rather than forensic evidence.
findings.cohortEvidence: 20/20 received NO_RED_FLAG_DETECTED. BAJFINANCE, LTIM and TATAMOTORS had FERE DATA_INSUFFICIENT with zero evidence yet still received the negative red-flag conclusion.
productionEvidence: Fresh capture shows the risk item evidence source UPSTOX_FUNDAMENTALS:competitors:<symbol>, not FERE
findings.requiredOutcome: Emit NO_RED_FLAG_DETECTED only where FERE has an evidence-backed sufficient/verified coverage result and the cited evidence belongs to the forensic review. Otherwise emit DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

findings.observedBehavior: QGLP labels non-bank longevity as PARTIAL with 'Historical balance sheet leverage supported' without consulting debt trajectory or debt evidence. It also applies that industrial assertion to an NBFC.
findings.cohortEvidence: 19/20 received this assertion while debtTrajectory was DATA_INSUFFICIENT or NOT_APPLICABLE. Examples: TCS DATA_INSUFFICIENT; BAJFINANCE NBFC/NOT_APPLICABLE; AAVAS DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
productionEvidence: src/server/services/intelligence/modules/QglpModuleAdapter.ts:235 assigns PARTIAL for every business model other than BANK
findings.requiredOutcome: Use debt/equity or leverage time series with dated evidence before any leverage/deleveraging conclusion. Banks and NBFCs require financial-institution-specific capital/liquidity treatment; otherwise the item is NOT_APPLICABLE or DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

findings.observedBehavior: When canonical sector/industry is absent, AAVAS is classified UNKNOWN. The fundamental path then treats UNKNOWN as non-financial and evaluates EBITDA margin, ROCE and industrial cash/leverage concepts instead of returning an explicit routing gap.
findings.cohortEvidence: AAVAS identity is 'Aavas Financiers Limited' with null sector/industry; product result businessModel=UNKNOWN, marginMetricUsed=EBITDA_MARGIN and QGLP says working-capital and balance-sheet items are partially evaluated.
productionEvidence: src/server/services/intelligence/domain/BusinessModelClassifier.ts returns UNKNOWN with absent canonical metadata
src/server/services/intelligence/modules/FundamentalModuleAdapter.ts:247 uses BANK/NBFC only for financial routing, treating UNKNOWN as industrial
findings.requiredOutcome: Unknown classification must fail closed for model-dependent financial interpretation. Resolve business model through verified identity metadata before routing; do not use industrial EBITDA, CFO/PAT, debt or return-profile logic for UNKNOWN.

arithmeticChecks.revenueGrowth: 20/20 independently recomputed latest/prior revenue growth values matched the captured fundamental trajectory values.
arithmeticChecks.marginBps: 17/17 non-financial companies with two revenue and EBITDA periods matched the independently recomputed margin bps change. BAJFINANCE was excluded because its financial-model route correctly withheld industrial margin output.
